> [!NOTE]
> This build is not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS will not open it the first time.
>
> 1. Unzip it and move Legato to Applications.
> 2. Open it. When macOS refuses, go to System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click **Open Anyway** next to the message about Legato.
>
> Updating from 0.2.2 or older? Those builds had no stable signature, so macOS asks once more for the Microphone and Accessibility permissions. If Legato does not react to the dictation key, remove it from System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, and add it again.
